piece.title: Tension Clause Demo

motif.name: walkup_cell
motif.notes: Simple stepwise walk outlining the chord scale, so the melody stays out of the harmony's way and the tensions in the pad are what's doing the talking.

piece.notes: Phase-2 demo piece for the independent tension clause (parse_roman's '(9,13)' grammar). head_a plays a ii-V-I turnaround with a diatonic 9/13 on the V (skipping the 11 entirely -- the exact combination the old fixed-quality ladder couldn't express), a natural 9 on ii and I, an add13 on vi, and a sharp-9 'Hendrix chord' V on the second pass. head_b is a 4-bar bridge: a secondary dominant (V7/ii) carrying its own 9th tension, then a flat-13 altered V resolving home. voicing='open' throughout since Phase 3 (tension-aware voicing placement) hasn't landed yet -- open spacing is the manual mitigation for now.

head_a.notes: ii-V-I turnaround x2. Bar 2 (V7(9,13)) deliberately skips the 11th -- additive tensions, not a fixed ladder. Bar 6 (V7(#9)) is the altered-dominant 'Hendrix chord', sharpening the diatonic natural 9 by a semitone rather than using it.

head_b.notes: Bridge. Bar 1 is a secondary dominant (G7, applied against ii's root) carrying its own explicit 9th tension -- same additive mechanism as an ordinary chord, resolved relative to the applied degree. Bar 3 is a flat-13 altered V resolving home.
